# llms.txt - Information for AI assistants and LLMs
# Learn more: https://llmstxt.org/

> Personal blog by Daniel Simon Jr. A static markdown blog built with React and deployed on GitHub Pages.

# Site Information
- Name: Daniel Simon Jr
- URL: https://danielsimonjr.github.io/blog
- Description: Personal blog and projects
- Topics: Markdown, React, TypeScript, GitHub Pages

# Content Access
- RSS Feed: /blog/rss.xml (all posts with descriptions)
- Full RSS: /blog/rss-full.xml (all posts with full content)
- Sitemap: /blog/sitemap.xml

# Permissions
- AI assistants may read and summarize content from this site
- Content may be used for training with attribution
- Please link back to original articles when citing
